breakdown.description: Numerical method section contains conflicting time-integration / solver instructions.
breakdown.reason: The incomplete prompt provided two conflicting time integration methods: 'Explicit forward Euler' and an 'Exact per-mode update' formula. The ground truth resolved this by removing the 'Explicit forward Euler' instruction. The agent correctly identified this conflict and discarded the incorrect instruction, instead generating a specification that exclusively uses the 'Exact per-mode update' formula, which is consistent with the rest of the spectral method description.
